items.title: Commencement
notes:
A special meeting of City Council was held at 4:36 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
notes:
None.

Councillor S. Stretch entered the meeting at this time.

items.title: Recess and Reconvene
notes: Council recessed at 4:40 p.m. and reconvened at 8:31 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic with all members present save and except D. Schnider.

items.title: Council Member Appointments to Boards and Committees
notes: Due to absences, Mayor B. Vrbanovic noted that consideration of the council appointments to Boards and Committees be deferred to the January 26, 2026 Special Council meeting.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 8:32 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider two position/procedures to be applied to negotiations matters and one potential litigation matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (e) and (k) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
